text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah~~~! I-It's the real Curren! So 
cuuuute~~!

Today was an open campus event. Curren 
Chan was surrounded by a massive crowd of 
visitors.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, they said we're wearing the Muse 
outfit today...! The one designed by 
Beauty Anshizawa...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll run wearing the Muse Racewear! 
Look forward to the mock race, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Getting to see Curren in that 
racewear up close! I'm so glad I came~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san! Looks like you're all set and 
ready!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bakushin O-san! Looking forward to the 
mock race~!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Those two are running in the mock 
race too!? That's a showdown between the 
strongest sprinters! Holy crap!!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A showdown of the strongest... Whoa, 
that's amazing!! Curren, you can 
definitely win! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ Thanks for cheering me on! Curren's 
gonna do her absolute best!

Amid great attention as a clash of the 
strongest sprinters, the mock race got 
underway.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, looking good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san is right on my tail. 
However—haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin! Keep on 
Bakushin-ing! Bakushin-shiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eep! What incredible speed...! So fast... 
Is this... Bakushin...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That was a splendid Bakushin! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... It's so incredible, 
Bakushin...! That is the true speed every 
Umamusume should strive for...!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I want to enter Tracen Academy...! I want 
to learn Bakushin from Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Me too...! I want to Bakushin too! 
Bakushin... Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: Observers
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren's... heading out now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san! That was a magnificent 
bakushin today...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! So the Bakushin 
reached you as well, Curren-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Bakushin without speed is no Bakushin 
at all. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! To think you understand so thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Because Curren's "cute" is just the same.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Making hearts flutter with a brilliant 
flash of cuteness—that's Curren's brand of 
'kawaii.'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A dazzling, vivid flash that burns into 
memory— That's Curren's own "cuteness." So 
next time, I'll definitely beat 
"Bakushin"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll be waiting! The battle between 
Curren-san and me is just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"This might be the first time I've ever 
seen Curren look so serious...! So cute... 
You're so cute, Curren!!"

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I felt Curren's fiery passion... loud and 
clear! We're definitely winning next time, 
Curren!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thank you, everyone. Curren will 
do her best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But the tour's not over yet! I'm gonna 
show you the absolute max of my cuteness 
at the concert♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin! Bakushin, 
Bakushin, Bakushin! Bakushin, Bakushin! 
Bakushin-shiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!! Man, this is crazy fun! You've 
got some wild energy today, Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A fusion of cute and Bakushin...! This 
kind of Curren is great too! So cute!!

Matching Sakura Bakushin O's blazing 
tempo, Curren Chan's moves are intense 
today as well. The entire venue is heating 
up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Bakushin O-san's song is so great! 
Curren wants to hear it with 
call-and-response too~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If it's Curren~, it has to be this, right? 
Cute, cute, so cute!

text_block_list.name: Observers
text_block_list.text: Cute cute cute! Cute! Cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we came up with a wonderful chant♪ 
Make sure to let me hear it a whuuule lot, 
okay!

This new call-and-response was 
incorporated into the live performances. 
And soon, Curren Chan's concerts gained a 
reputation for their incredible sense of 
unity and fun!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, found a Curren fan♪

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hauah!! So cute... I love her... Cute 
Curren Chan...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san, let's thank everyone 
together with our special pose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! So, what's this special pose 
of yours?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Please copy Curren. Okay, here we go~...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Kyururu~nâª

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
S-So... ADORABLE!! Both of them are total 
angels! Cuteness is supreme!!

And so, Curren Chan unleashed her maximum 
cuteness during the live 
performance—leaving the observers utterly 
captivated by her charm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't take your eyes off Curren. 
*Sparkle*♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, we're still going to Bakushin 
onward!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Cutie and Bakushin are 
swirling together on the stage...!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Neither yields their own ground, which 
creates a chemical reaction that results 
in a truly one-of-a-kind live 
performance...!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Something only fellow Tracen Academy 
students can do...! Curren and the others 
are showing us just that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, why don't you all come enjoy 
cuteness with Curren at Tracen Academy 
too?♪

text_block_list.name: Observers
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeeees! Cute Curren Chan!!

And after the live concert, almost all the 
visitors apparently submitted applications 
to Tracen Academy. Once again, I was 
reminded of the sheer power of cuteness...
